## Checklist

- [ ] Still one file: `banner/index.html` in plain HTML, CSS and ES5 JavaScript. No build step, no dependencies, no external requests.
- [ ] Tested at 320 px, 390 px, desktop and 1600 px or wider, in at least one non-Latin language (`?lang=zh-HK`, `?lang=ru-RU`), on both screens of the dialog.
- [ ] Every line-height inside the banner is still a whole number of pixels and nothing overflows the dialog at 320 px.
- [ ] Dictionary changes: every key present in every language, links written as `[label](key)`, `langName` in the language itself, wording neutral.
- [ ] Screenshots attached for anything visual.
- [ ] README and CHANGELOG updated if behaviour, API, configuration or texts changed.
